lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: In an editable GTMultiPolygon layer draw a bow-tie outer ring by walk or vertices
Repeat the manual self-crossing edit with both a minimal bow-tie and additional vertices
Press Save and inspect the repaired geometry before completing the single attribute form
Save attributes, reopen the feature and synchronize it
Repeat with overlapping multi-polygon parts and with a valid hole
Start a new GTMultiPolygon, leave only its initial centre node and press Save
Repeat a self-crossing shape in GTPolygon and a line layer
value.expected: Invalid multi-polygon topology becomes one valid GeoMultiPolygon feature with all resulting parts, original CRS and valid holes; exactly one form owns the attributes and every repair started from the MapLibre editor retains Web Mercator CRS; the feature survives reopen and sync. An unrecoverable result stays in geometry editing without a partial insert. A one-node MultiPolygon stays in editing and reports insufficient points, never repair failure. Simple Polygon and line layers are not auto-repaired.
